Symmetry proves the independent pole sign. The included independent deterministic and Monte Carlo checker supports each step without replacing analytic proof.

value.rationale: Complete isotropic width distribution of the classical Steinmetz bicylinder is a natural, previously unverified exact geometric invariant. The logarithmic lower singularity has a sharply explained geometric origin in crossing great circles, and the conditional uniform logarithmic scale-splitting and pole concentration are a genuinely non-obvious selection phenomenon, not a parameter substitution or finite calculation. Two endpoint exponents and exact mean-square give independent geometric benchmarks.
